_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score 29 sits in Panic (24-31) with Denial (32-38) one rung up — the coil base rate (3% of windows move ±2+) makes HOLD the skilled call, but if the coil breaks the path of least resistance is down into Anxiety as negative momentum and fear sentiment have not yet fully washed out.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward-calls Disbelief (illegal, 2+ rungs from anchor) while narrative implies upside mean reversion; consensus overrides to a legal HOLD with Anxiety as the only coherent adjacent downside risk.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows climb above 30 AND stablecoin growth turns positive — institutional re-entry breaks the coil upward toward Denial/Hope
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 25 with funding turning negative and BTC momentum stalling below 50 — risk-off slide accelerates through Anxiety toward Capitulation
